$schema: Exceptions file for check-security.ts. Each exception needs reason, reviewer, and expiry (max ~30 days).

exceptions.reason: No patched release exists (vulnerable <=4.0.7, latest is 4.0.7). picomatch is only reached through glob tooling: @changesets/config and @changesets/git (release tooling), @parcel/watcher under @tailwindcss/cli (CSS build), @manypkg/tools, and tinyglobby/fdir under @ts-morph/common (feature-ast codemods over the app's own source tree). All of them match glob patterns from repo or project config; no runtime request path hands request or user input to picomatch, so the extglob ReDoS is not reachable from outside. Drop once picomatch ships a fix.
